Emily — great to meet you via email and thanks for the account export. I pulled together a concise "account cartography" approach we use to align Partner Center referrals to field sellers and remove claim friction. TL;DR: 1) canonical account spreadsheet, 2) Partner Center referral IDs matched to contoso account numbers, 3) field-seller handshake (owner confirmations + canary claim window), 4) documentation & MOU.

Next steps I propose:
- Vanessa and Karthik and I will run a lightweight mapping pass on the CSV (we’ll return a mapped file with MS referral IDs and suggested owner assignments).
- We’ll surface any account ownership conflicts (overlaps / orphaned accounts) and provide a recommended owner per account.
- Schedule a 45-min alignment with Contoso + MS partner team to confirm owners and agree on the referral acceptance SLA (we typically ask for 3 business days).

I attached a draft MOU and a Partner Center referral template you can preview. Also linking our HubSpot record for the deal (see links).

Questions for you now: any accounts with special procurement or reseller relationships we should treat differently? Also, do you have a designated Contoso seller contact at Microsoft (name/email) besides the Partner Center inbox?

Ben Carter

Thanks — I’ll lead the owner reconciliation and field-seller handshake. A few operational notes from the field:
- If multiple MS sellers claim the same account, we propose a short arbitration window where Contoso confirms the seller relationship (2 business days).
- For large enterprise accounts (> $250k ARR) we recommend a pre-call with the assigned MS seller to land the go-to-market narrative.
- We will mark accounts as "canary" vs "pilot" to sequence outreach and limit churn during the claim window.

Proposed timeline: mapping pass by EOD Wed (May 5), ship mapped workbook + conflict list, 45-min alignment call Thurs May 6 or Fri May 7.
